slides.findLeads.title: She finds and prioritizes high-intent leads
slides.findLeads.desc: Search 250M+ verified B2B contacts or import from your CRM. Ava enriches prospects using 22+ data sources, then prioritizes them by likelihood to convert using intent signals like funding rounds and leadership hires.
slides.findLeads.mockup.profileTitle: VP of Sales at CloudScale · avery@cloudscale.com
slides.findLeads.mockup.enrich2: Detected leadership shift: Avery joined 2 months ago
slides.sequences.title: She launches personalized multi-channel sequences
slides.sequences.desc: Ava sends personalized outreach across email and social. She queues call steps in the native dialer so your reps can click and dial without leaving the platform.
slides.sequences.mockup.title: Outbound Sequence
slides.testing.title: She tests and optimizes messaging automatically
slides.testing.desc: Ava runs dozens of message variations per campaign simultaneously, testing subject lines, structure, CTAs, and tone. She shifts volume toward what's working so performance compounds over time.

slides.testing.mockup.overlay.title: Ava shifting send volume to winners
slides.replies.title: She handles replies and books meetings autonomously
slides.replies.desc: Ava handles every reply. She qualifies interested leads, handles objections, and books meetings directly on your reps' calendars. You set escalation rules to decide when a human gets pulled in.
slides.replies.mockup.title: Artisan Inbox
slides.replies.mockup.reply1: This sounds interesting. But do you integrate with Salesforce?
slides.replies.mockup.reply2: Yes, we support native sync with Salesforce to automate contact tracking, sequence stats, and pipeline growth directly.
